name: fluentmcp
description: Full control of FluentCRM and FluentCart on your WordPress site: contacts, campaigns, orders, products, subscriptions, and more.
long_description: Gives your AI assistant create/read/update/delete control over FluentCRM (email marketing & CRM) and FluentCart (e-commerce) by WPManageNinja — 699 documented REST endpoints reachable through 44 consolidated tools. Safe by default: every destructive action (deletes, refunds, cancels, mass-sends, resets) is annotated and refuses to run without explicit confirmation. One WordPress Application Password runs everything; run the verify_setup tool after installing to check your connection.

site_url.title: WordPress Site URL
site_url.description: Your WordPress site root, e.g. https://example.com (not the /wp-admin URL).

api_username.title: WordPress Username
api_username.description: The WordPress admin user the server acts as (needs FluentCRM/FluentCart permissions).

api_password.title: Application Password
api_password.description: Create under WP Admin → Users → your user → Application Passwords → Add New. One password runs both FluentCRM and FluentCart tools.

tools.name: verify_setup
tools.description: Check site reachability, credentials, and plugin presence — run this first.

tools.name: crm_contacts
tools.description: Look up, create, update, delete, and manage CRM contacts (subscribers), including their notes, tags, lists, and email history.

tools.name: crm_lists
tools.description: View, create, update, or delete the contact lists used to organize CRM subscribers.

tools.name: crm_tags
tools.description: View, create, update, or delete the tags used to label CRM contacts.

tools.name: crm_segments
tools.description: View, create, update, or delete dynamic contact segments and see which contacts match them.

tools.name: crm_custom_fields
tools.description: View or update the custom contact fields configured in the CRM.

tools.name: crm_labels
tools.description: View, create, update, or delete the labels used to organize items in the CRM.

tools.name: crm_companies
tools.description: Look up, create, update, delete, and manage CRM companies, their notes, and their associated contacts.

tools.name: crm_campaigns
tools.description: Create, schedule, send, pause, duplicate, delete, and analyze one-off email campaigns, including resending failed or unopened emails.

tools.name: crm_recurring_campaigns
tools.description: Manage recurring (automatically repeating) email campaigns from creation through scheduling and deletion (FluentCRM Pro).

tools.name: crm_sequences
tools.description: Manage email sequence (drip) automations, their emails, and their subscribers (FluentCRM Pro).

tools.name: crm_automations
tools.description: Manage marketing automation funnels and their subscribers, from creation and editing to import, export, and deletion.

tools.name: crm_templates
tools.description: Manage reusable email templates, including creating, duplicating, updating, and deleting them.

tools.name: crm_forms
tools.description: View and manage the opt-in forms connected to the CRM.

tools.name: crm_webhooks
tools.description: Manage incoming webhooks that create or update CRM contacts from external services.

tools.name: crm_smart_links
tools.description: Manage Smart Links that tag and redirect contacts when clicked (FluentCRM Pro).

tools.name: crm_sms
tools.description: Manage SMS campaigns, templates, contacts' phone data, and SMS settings (FluentCRM Pro).

tools.name: crm_reports
tools.description: Read-only CRM analytics: dashboard stats, subscriber growth, email and revenue reports, commerce reports, and global search.

tools.name: crm_abandoned_carts
tools.description: View abandoned-cart records and their report summary, and delete records in bulk (FluentCRM Pro commerce feature).

tools.name: crm_settings
tools.description: Read or update FluentCRM settings such as double opt-in, business info, email preferences, compliance, and experimental features.

tools.name: crm_settings_pro
tools.description: Read or update FluentCRM Pro settings such as the plugin license and Pro-only features.

tools.name: crm_utilities
tools.description: Administrative utilities: import contacts from CSV or WordPress users, migrate from other tools, list WordPress users and roles, browse in-app docs, and receive bounce webhooks.

tools.name: cart_orders
tools.description: Look up, create, update, refund, and manage store orders, including their statuses, transactions, addresses, and disputes.

tools.name: cart_products
tools.description: Look up, create, update, delete, and bulk-edit store products, including search, duplication, taxonomy terms, and shipping/tax classes.

tools.name: cart_product_variants
tools.description: Manage product variations: pricing, inventory and stock, bundles, upgrade paths, media, and variant search.

tools.name: cart_product_assets
tools.description: Manage products' downloadable files and per-product integration feeds.

tools.name: cart_customers
tools.description: Look up, create, update, and manage store customers, their addresses, purchase stats, and linked WordPress users.

tools.name: cart_coupons
tools.description: Manage discount coupons: create, update, delete, apply to or remove from orders, and check product eligibility.

tools.name: cart_subscriptions
tools.description: View and manage recurring subscriptions: cancel, re-sync from the payment gateway, switch payment methods, and handle early payments.

tools.name: cart_tax
tools.description: Manage tax classes, tax rates, per-country configuration, EU VAT/OSS overrides, and order tax records.

tools.name: cart_shipping
tools.description: Manage shipping zones, shipping methods, and shipping classes.

tools.name: cart_settings
tools.description: Read or update store settings: general store options, modules and addons, permissions, payment methods, storage drivers, and checkout fields.

tools.name: cart_email_notifications
tools.description: Manage the store's transactional email templates, global email settings, reminders, and previews.

tools.name: cart_reports
tools.description: Read-only store analytics: revenue, orders, products, customers, subscriptions, refunds, licenses, and dashboard summaries.

tools.name: cart_integrations
tools.description: Manage global integration feeds and provider settings, and install or activate integration addons.

tools.name: cart_files
tools.description: List, upload, and delete files in the store's configured storage drivers.

tools.name: cart_labels_attributes
tools.description: Manage store labels and product attribute groups and their terms.

tools.name: cart_utilities
tools.description: Store utilities: dashboard stats and onboarding, activity log, order notes, print templates, country data, filter options, and retention snapshots.

tools.name: cart_storefront
tools.description: Read-only public storefront data: published products, rendered product listings, and product search — no authentication required.

tools.name: cart_checkout
tools.description: Checkout-session operations: place an order, fetch payment and shipping info for the cart, and log a customer in.

tools.name: cart_customer_portal
tools.description: Customer-portal operations on the logged-in customer's own profile, orders, addresses, subscriptions, and downloads.

tools.name: cart_licensing
tools.description: Manage software licenses: view, extend, regenerate keys, change limits, activate or deactivate sites, plus the public license verification endpoints (FluentCart Pro).

tools.name: cart_roles
tools.description: Manage FluentCart shop roles, permissions, and user assignments (FluentCart Pro).

tools.name: cart_order_bumps
tools.description: Manage checkout order bumps: list, create, update, and delete (FluentCart Pro).
